title: 第23章 幼稚的男神第24章 害羞你确定
lines: 第23章幼稚的男神
虽然搬进来是被权天睿硬逼着搬进来的，但是现在，她对于景园，貌似有了那么点点归宿感，当然也只有一点点而已，想到今晚那离去的背影，夏天就想的好想叹气。
难道是他突然觉得，自己于他来说，腻了？
想到这个可能，心里更是堵得慌。
明明以前她都盼着离婚，盼着他对自己失去兴趣，但是现在想到那种可能心里就难受。
不顾杨素素的震惊，夏天瘸着腿直接朝景园大门走去。
门卫见着是少夫人回来了，赶紧开了门。
杨素素虽然是震惊的，但是看着夏天瘸着腿艰难的走路，连忙收起了那些情绪，上去将夏天搀扶着。
“明明受伤不轻了，都不开口叫我扶你，也不知道你这逞能的性子什么时候能改改。”
杨素素对夏天这要强的性子很是不满，也不是被她埋怨多少次了，她都不过只是一笑了之。
现在的夏天也是如此，她不坚强，谁会为他撑腰？
从小到大，她早已经习惯了这样孤独而又坚强的她。
二人直接走进了屋里，“少夫人回来了。”李管家热情的迎了过来。
杨素素要是此刻还认为这房子是夏天买的话，那简直就是智障了。
就算她再有钱，也不是那种可以雇佣一堆人在家里伺候自己的那种人。
这才想起来之前她说她已经结婚了的事情。
我勒个去，难道是真的？
此刻的杨素素心里，犹如万马奔腾而过的心情。
看向夏天，那双眼睛恨不得将夏天瞪出一个洞来。
她记得她还说过，她结婚的对象是权天睿，告诉我，这不是真的？
李管家看到少夫人回来不由的松了口气，方才少爷回来就问少夫人在哪儿，说出去了之后，周围的空气瞬间降了好几度。
貌似他又恢复到了没有遇到少夫人的那些日子了，冰冷的不近人情。
“少夫人，少爷在书房。”
本来以为夏天会去书房直接找少爷，却没有想到。
“恩，对了，帮我给我朋友安排个客房。”
“好的，少夫人。”见夏天没有想要去书房的样子，李管家怀着郁郁的心情，转身去给杨素素收拾客房去了。
李管家走了之后，杨素素直接扑到夏天的身上，“说，你结婚的对象真的是权天睿？”
夏天一时不查，直接被杨素素给扑进了沙发里，两个女人扭成了一团。
夏天的脚一抬，直接撞向了茶几上，疼痛那是肯定的。
杨素素也意识到了自己太过激，导致忘记了她还有伤在身。
“啊，我忘记了，怎么样，有没有肿起来？”
杨素素想要赶紧起来，却被楼梯上的生意直接打断了。
“你在做什么？”
因为杨素素本来就是一头利落的帅气的短发，加上今天还穿了一件黑色的T恤，一时间让权天睿分不清男女还是有那个可能的。
听到身后的声音，杨素素连忙起身。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Childish male god
Although she was forced to move in by Quan Tianrui, now, she seems to have a little sense of belonging to Jingyuan, of course only a little bit. Thinking of the departing figure tonight, Xia Tian wants to sigh.
Could it be that he suddenly felt that he was tired of him?
Thinking of this possibility, my heart became even more panicked.
She had obviously been looking forward to divorce and him losing interest in her before, but now she felt uncomfortable thinking about that possibility.
Ignoring Yang Susu's shock, Xia Tian limped and walked directly towards the gate of Jingyuan.
When the doorman saw that the young lady had returned, he quickly opened the door.
Although Yang Susu was shocked, seeing Xia Tian walking with difficulty with a limp leg, she quickly put away those emotions and went up to help Xia Tian.
"You're obviously seriously injured, but you didn't even ask me to help you. I don't know when your showy temper will change."
Yang Susu was very dissatisfied with Xia Tian's strong temper. No matter how many times she complained, she just laughed it off.
The same is true for Xia Tian now. If she is not strong, who will support him?
She has been accustomed to being so lonely and strong since she was a child.
The two walked directly into the room. "The young lady is back." Butler Li greeted him enthusiastically.
If Yang Susu still thinks that this house was bought in the summer, she is simply retarded.
No matter how rich she is, she is not the kind of person who can hire a bunch of people to serve her at home.
Then I remembered what she said before that she was married.
Let me tell you, is it true?
At this moment, Yang Susu's heart felt like thousands of horses galloping past.
Looking at Xia Tian, ​​those eyes wanted to make a hole in Xia Tian.
She remembered that she also said that the person she married was Quan Tianrui. Tell me, is this not true?
Butler Li couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief when he saw the young lady coming back. Just now when the young master came back, he asked where the young lady was. After telling him that she had gone out, the surrounding air dropped several degrees in an instant.
It seems that he has returned to the days before he met the young lady, cold and inhumane.
"Madam, the young master is in the study."
She originally thought that Xia Tian would go to the study to find the young master directly, but she didn't expect that.
"Well, by the way, help me arrange a guest room for my friend."
"Okay, young lady." Seeing that Xia Tian didn't want to go to the study, Butler Li turned around and went to clean up the guest room for Yang Susu with a gloomy mood.
After Butler Li left, Yang Susu pounced directly on Xia Tian, "Tell me, is the person you are marrying really Quan Tianrui?"
Xia Tian didn't check for a moment, but was thrown directly into the sofa by Yang Susu, and the two women twisted into a ball.
"Ah...it hurts!"
Xia Tian raised his foot and hit it directly on the coffee table. The pain was definitely there.
Yang Susu also realized that she was too aggressive and forgot that she was still injured.
"Ah, I forgot. How is it? Is it swollen?"
Yang Susu wanted to get up quickly, but was interrupted by the business on the stairs.
"What are you doing?"
Because Yang Susu originally had neat and handsome short hair, and she was wearing a black T-shirt today, it was possible that Quan Tianrui couldn't tell the difference between men and women for a while.
Hearing the voice behind him, Yang Susu stood up quickly.
